About

Every second has to earn its place

I'm a Creative Video Editor with 7 years of experience turning raw footage and creative briefs into clear, engaging content for brands, creators, and digital platforms. I edit short-form social videos, YouTube content, podcasts, UGC, product ads, interviews, and brand stories, combining editorial judgment, platform-aware pacing, polished post-production, and AI-assisted creative workflows.

Adobe Premiere Pro After Effects DaVinci Resolve Final Cut Pro CapCut Element 3D AI-Assisted Production Color & Audio Finishing
Services

What I edit

One editor from first cut to final export. Tell me what the video needs to do and I'll shape it around that.

01

Short-Form & Social Video

Platform-aware edits for Reels, TikTok, and Shorts, built with strong openings, clear messaging, intentional pacing, B-roll, and captions.

02

Long-Form & YouTube

YouTube videos and brand stories shaped through story assembly, dialogue tightening, visual sequencing, and retention-focused pacing.

03

Color & Audio Finishing

Color correction, shot matching, dialogue cleanup, music and sound effects placement, audio balancing, and final mix checks.

04

Motion Graphics & Captions

Animated text, titles, lower thirds, transitions, product callouts, captions, and brand-consistent visual treatments.

05

UGC, Product Ads & Brand Content

UGC-style creatives, product and e-commerce videos, direct-response ads, and promotional edits shaped around the brief and brand voice.

06

Podcast & Interview Editing

Dialogue-focused edits with tighter conversations, thoughtful B-roll, clean audio, readable captions, and a polished viewing experience.

Process

How we work together

Simple, clear, and no guessing about what happens next.

01

Brief

Send me your footage and tell me what the video needs to do.

02

First cut

I edit for pacing, story, and style, then send you a first version.

03

Refine

You send your feedback and I adjust the cut to match.

04

Delivery

You get the final files exported in the formats you need.
